SELECT concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id='Drug'
  AND concept_class_id='Ingredient'
  AND standard_concept='S'
  AND LOWER(concept_name) IN ('teriparatide','abaloparatide','romosozumab','alendronate','risedronate','ibandronate','etidronate')
ORDER BY concept_name;

SELECT concept_id, concept_name, domain_id, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id='Visit'
  AND LOWER(concept_name) IN ('inpatient visit','emergency room visit','emergency room and inpatient visit')
ORDER BY concept_name;

SELECT TOP 100 concept_id, concept_name, vocabulary_id, concept_class_id, standard_concept, concept_code
FROM omop.concept
WHERE domain_id='Condition'
  AND standard_concept='S'
  AND LOWER(concept_name) LIKE '%osteoporosis%'
ORDER BY concept_name;
